summary: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions.
takeaways: On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness.
Accelerate Bench pairs executable workloads with agents' programs and trajectories to evaluate both their gains and the process behind them.
We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions.
